Remark
[Non-separating surgery spheres prevent extending the comparison map] ↗ prop:surgery-distance-decreasing

A nonseparating surgery sphere gives a post-surgery component with caps on both sides, so the comparison map cannot extend continuously over the entire pre-surgery component.
